querySql:
select 
                                      id,
                                      stock_code,
                                      stock_name,
                                      con_date,
                                      con_year,
                                      con_or_rank,
                                      con_np_rank,
                                      con_eps_rank,
                                      con_na_rank,
                                      con_pb_rank,
                                      con_ps_rank,
                                      con_pe_rank,
                                      con_peg_rank,
                                      con_roe_rank,
                                      con_or_yoy_rank,
                                      con_np_yoy_rank,
                                      con_npcgrate_2y_rank,
                                      con_npgrate_1w_rank,
                                      con_npgrate_4w_rank,
                                      con_npgrate_13w_rank,
                                      con_npgrate_26w_rank,
                                      con_npgrate_52w_rank,
                                      entrytime,
                                      updatetime,
                                      tmstamp,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'zyyx_der_forecast_rank.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.der_forecast_rank WHERE con_date BETWEEN '${beg_date}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${beg_date}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
